name: Stasharr
description: Intercepts Xtream Codes (XC) VOD playback requests and redirects players to Streamcache using canonical Dispatcharr playback URLs.
author: bruor

fields.label: Enable Stasharr Interceptor
fields.help_text: Master switch to enable or disable XC VOD redirection to Streamcache.
fields.description: Master switch to enable or disable XC VOD redirection to Streamcache.

fields.label: Delivery Mode
fields.description: Choose delivery mode: 'Proxy' (Default) in-line streams through Dispatcharr with native stream termination and zero Nginx buffering; 'Redirect' offloads to Streamcache with HTTP 429 gate rejection.
fields.help_text: In Proxy mode, Dispatcharr manages the connection, supporting native 'Terminate on Limit Exceeded' to kill victim streams. In Redirect mode, streams are offloaded to Streamcache; Dispatcharr cannot terminate external connections, so limit enforcement acts as an admission gate that rejects new streams with HTTP 429.

options.label: Proxy (Default - Native Connection Limits, Stream Termination & Zero Nginx Buffering)
Redirect (Direct Streamcache Offload & HTTP 429 Abuse Gate)

fields.label: Streamcache Base URL
fields.help_text: In Proxy mode (Default), Dispatcharr connects directly to Streamcache from inside the container network to stream media to clients; use an internal container address (e.g., http://streamcache:8080). In Redirect mode, Dispatcharr sends an HTTP 302 redirecting the player's device directly to Streamcache; this must be a client-accessible URL (e.g., https://streamcache.yourdomain.ca) that Dispatcharr can also reach for session queries.
fields.description: In Proxy mode (Default), the internal endpoint Dispatcharr contacts to proxy media (e.g., http://streamcache:8080). In Redirect mode, the client-facing endpoint players are redirected to (e.g., https://streamcache.yourdomain.ca).

fields.label: Dispatcharr Base URL
fields.help_text: The canonical Dispatcharr base URL passed inside the target ?url= parameter that Streamcache uses to fetch media via /proxy/vod/... on cache misses. Setting this explicitly to match dp2strm ensures all requests use identical pathing and produce identical MD5 cache keys regardless of how a client connected.
